jobs.title: Senior Director, Platform
jobs.description:
About Miovision: 
 At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!
 All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

 One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

 Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

 Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

 Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

 Position Summary: 
 At Miovision, we are engineering the future of smart transportation, and right now, we are laying down the asphalt for our most ambitious infrastructure project yet. We are building a governed, API-first technology platform that will act as the ultimate express lane for how we build software, enabling new experiences for customers, partners, and AI agents. We are looking for a Senior Director, Platform to serve as the master traffic controller for this massive transformation. Reporting to the SVP of Software Engineering & Technology, you will build the foundational highways that our entire product ecosystem travels on. You will steer our engineering organization away from gridlocked, application-centric development and into a high-speed, contract-driven future. If you are a hands-on leader ready to pave the way for AI-assisted innovation and ensure our platform capabilities always get the green light, it is time to take the wheel!

 Objectives and Responsibilities: 
 Platform Strategy & Architectural Foundation 
 Own the engineering strategy and translate our Platform North Star into clear architectural priorities for both human and AI-driven use cases.

 Spearhead the transition from application-centric integration toward a governed, contract-driven, API-first platform.

 Partner with Architecture to establish a durable technical foundation that protects long-term integrity while pragmatically supporting near-term delivery.

 Drive an engineering culture where teams naturally build on the platform because it is the absolute fastest and most effective path to delivering value.

 Organizational Leadership & Scaling 
 Lead, coach, and aggressively grow the Platform Engineering organization by recruiting top-tier talent with deep expertise in APIs, distributed systems, and AI.

 Build a highly resilient team culture grounded in ownership, curiosity, technical excellence, and high-velocity delivery.

 Lead the shift toward platform-first ways of working, building alignment, adoption, and accountability across the broader Engineering department.

 Create an environment where senior engineers are highly empowered to make decisions while remaining perfectly aligned with a shared architectural direction.

 Platform as a Product (First-Party, Third-Party & Ecosystem Enablement) 
 Partner with Product Leadership to operate the Platform exactly like a customer-facing product, treating internal developers, external partners, and AI agents as your core customers.

 Establish API contracts as first-class products that natively support authentication, observability, usage metering, and scalable commercial models from day one.

 Build a governed, unified entry point for Miovision's strategic capabilities, utilizing adoption data and developer feedback to continuously improve the ecosystem.

 Identify and build reusable, standardized capabilities—partnering with Data Science to integrate models and data products—eliminating isolated alternatives across the company.

 Technical Leadership & Hands-On Builder 
 Remain deeply engaged in the technology—reviewing architecture, exploring code, and prototyping solutions alongside your engineers to blast through ambiguity.

 Build the technical foundations for AI-assisted development, personally utilizing modern agentic tools and establishing AI-native practices across your team.

 Partner with Developer Operations to build automation and tooling that makes standardized, scalable architecture the absolute easiest path for our engineers.

 Bring razor-sharp technical judgment to complex distributed systems, helping teams practically evolve existing architecture without requiring massive, disruptive rewrites.

 Operational Excellence, Reliability & Trust 
 Establish world-class reliability, observability, security, and operational readiness as the fundamental DNA of all Platform capabilities.

 Ensure human and agent identity, delegated authorization, auditability, and guardrails are natively built into the platform rather than siloed across individual teams.

 Define strict lifecycle, compatibility, and service health standards so consumers can depend on Platform services with absolute confidence.

 Ensure the Platform seamlessly scales alongside Miovision’s rapidly growing products, customer base, and engineering organization without multiplying operational complexity.

 The Ideal Profile: 
 The Engineering Veteran: You bring 15+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on platform engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale architecture.

 The Organization Builder: You have a proven track record of successfully leading, scaling, and coaching senior engineering teams in highly complex, multi-product environments.

 The API Architect: You boast deep technical expertise in API design, microservices, contract governance, and full API lifecycle management.

 The Platform Product Thinker: You treat platforms exactly like a product. Experience monetizing a platform, scaling a marketplace, or building a third-party developer ecosystem is strongly preferred.

 The AI-Native Leader: You have hands-on experience executing platform strategies that fundamentally change how engineering teams use AI to build, verify, and deliver software (including exposure to MCP and machine-readable interfaces).

 The Hands-On Builder: You are a highly credible technical leader who is just as comfortable exploring code and prototyping a solution as you are driving an executive strategy meeting.

 The Cloud Heavyweight: You have deep, practical familiarity with cloud-native architectures (AWS), Kubernetes, modern CI/CD, and languages like Java, Python, or Node.js.

 The Transformation Driver: You have demonstrated experience successfully driving massive architectural or engineering operating-model shifts within an organization.

 The Operations Sentinel: You possess a profound understanding of reliability, telemetry, security, and operational excellence in massive, high-stakes production systems.

 The Strategic Diplomat: You wield excellent communication and influence skills, capable of partnering flawlessly with Product Management, Architecture, and C-suite stakeholders.

 The Pragmatic Visionary: You excel at systems thinking—perfectly balancing the need for long-term architectural integrity with the reality of pragmatic, incremental delivery.

 Your Rewards & Well-being: 
We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.
 Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.

 Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.

 Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.

 Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

 Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together! 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please indicate if you require accommodation on your application, and our team will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

These tools are one of several factors considered in the hiring process and do not replace human judgement. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions.

We communicate directly with applicants and will not request banking information, payment, or fees during any point of the recruitment process. We do not conduct interviews via text message. If you suspect that a third party is impersonating Miovision or requesting payment for recruitment on behalf of Miovision, please alert us via recruitment@miovision.com.

Whether you're solving problems, building systems, or shaping strategy, your work fuels real support for real people.

 Discretionary Annual Bonus: Enjoy the opportunity for a discretionary bonus based on individual performance and company success.

 Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits include health and dental plans with 100% of the premiums covered. We also offer an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well-being and provide resources for personal challenges.

 Perks and Rewards: Enjoy reimbursement for tuition assistance and professional development, discounts through Perkopolis and participate in our rewards and recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

 What You’ll Do 

 The Job:  Director, Data Architecture & Information Management

 As the  Director, Data Architecture & Information Management, you will serve as the organization’s designated authority and strategic leader for enterprise data architecture. Working across major business and technology initiatives, you will influence key decisions and lead the evolution of the enterprise data systems architecture, enterprise data model, and Master Data Management (MDM) capabilities.

 This leadership role is accountable for setting the strategic direction for data and establishing the standards, patterns, information models, and architecture review processes that govern how data is designed, integrated, and managed across the enterprise. Through this work, you will enable trusted, scalable, and reusable information assets that support business operations, analytics, digital initiatives, and AI capabilities.

 What You’ll Do 

 Provide architectural leadership and design oversight across major projects, programs, and technology initiatives that impact enterprise data.

 Partner with business and technology leaders to define future-state data capabilities and architecture roadmaps aligned with strategic priorities.

 Define and lead the organization’s Master Data Management (MDM) strategy, architecture, and roadmap, beginning with customer data and expanding across additional domains.

 Own and evolve the enterprise canonical data model and business information architecture to improve consistency, interoperability, reuse, and scalability.

 Establish and govern enterprise data architecture standards, design patterns, information models, reference architectures, and architecture review processes.

 Lead enterprise data modeling, metadata architecture, information lifecycle management, and related architectural practices.

 Evaluate emerging technologies, data platforms, and AI capabilities to strengthen the enterprise data architecture and create business value.

 Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of Data Architects, Data Modelers, and Data Engineers..

 What You’ll Bring 

 Required Qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline.

 10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise data architecture, information architecture, data modeling, and information management.

 Proven success influencing enterprise-wide business and technology decisions through architectural leadership.

 Experience partnering with Enterprise, Solution, and Cloud Architects to establish end-to-end architecture strategies.

 Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise data standards, architecture patterns, and governance processes.

 Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling.

 Experience leading Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives and enterprise information management programs.

 Experience developing enterprise information models, integration standards, and reference architectures.

 Proven ability to collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to define future-state architecture roadmaps.

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Master’s degree in a related discipline.

 Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry.

 Experience designing or supporting modern cloud-based data platforms, preferably Snowflake.

 Experience with modern data transformation and modeling practices using dbt or similar technologies.

 Experience enabling AI, advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and digital transformation initiatives.

 Experience building and leading architecture or information management teams.

 MFSG is committed to accommodating applicants up to the point of undue hardship during the recruitment, assessment and selection process. If you are selected for an interview, please notify MFSG if you require accommodation in respect of the materials or procedures used at any time during this process. If you require accommodation, MFSG will work with you to determine how to meet your needs.
  

 About MFSG – Our Commitment to Responsible Innovation

 At MFSG, we are committed to building innovative solutions grounded in ethical, transparent, and responsible use of data and technology. Aligned with the principles outlined in Canada’s Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA), we take a proactive approach to ensuring that any AI or data-driven systems we use are safe, fair, and accountable.

 This posting is for a current position within our organization, offering the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, responsible innovation that supports our employees, clients, and communities. 

 We prioritize strong data governance, clear communication around how systems work, and safeguards that reduce risks and protect individuals. Our focus is on developing tools and processes that promote equity, reliability, and trust, supported by ongoing monitoring and continuous improvement.

 Joining MFSG means contributing to a future-focused organization that values both innovation and integrity, where your work helps shape solutions that responsibly support our employees, clients, and communities.

At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.

 Computer Vision

jobs.description:

 Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.
 What you'll do 
 Prospecting & lead generation: Identify and target potential customers through research, networking, and cold calling. Build new relationships with our enterprise customers and prospects to drive revenue, pipeline, and deployment capacity.

 Manage relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders with our largest customers. Serve as their primary point of contact and exceed their expectations.

 Negotiating & closing complex deal cycles: Lead negotiations with existing and prospective customers, addressing objections and closing deals. Navigate contracts and agreements quickly and effectively, working closely with legal and finance stakeholders.

 Sales strategy & planning: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets. Craft tailored sales presentations and proposals that meet our enterprise customers needs. Collaborate with our marketing team to implement effective sales campaigns and presentations.

 Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with our broader GTM team, as well as our product, technical and operations orgs to deliver our industry-leading product.

 Operate as an AI-native seller: Leverage AI tools across the full sales cycle- account research, personalized outreach, call summarization, pipeline forecasting, and deal execution- to automate low-value tasks and reinvest that time into high-value customer relationships, while continuously adopting and experimenting with new tools to work faster and smarter than traditional methods allow.

 What you'll bring 
 6-8 years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

 Enterprise experience: Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex 6- and 7-figure ACV deals.

 Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

 Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

 Prospecting & lead generation: Proven track record of identifying and targeting potential enterprise clients through research, networking, and cold calling.

 Even better... 
 Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.

 Our values 
 Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

 What we offer 
 We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:
 Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 Life insurance and disability benefits

 Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 Parental leave

 Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 Free alphorn lessons

 These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

 We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. jobs.title: VP Technology & Innovation
jobs.description:
Teladoc Health is the global virtual care leader, offering comprehensive virtual care solutions spanning virtual care including primary, mental health, expert medical, devices and licensed platform services. Teladoc Health serves the world's leading insurers, employers, and health systems and helps millions of people around the world resolve their healthcare needs with confidence. Serving over 9 million Canadians, Teladoc Health has been in Canada for more than 20 years and operates in 175 countries world-wide.

 Position Summary 

 The Vice President, Technology and Innovation (“VP”) is responsible for defining and executing Teladoc Health Canada’s technology, product, innovation and cybersecurity strategy. The VP leads the development and delivery of Teladoc Health Canada's digital products and technology ecosystem, including product management, software engineering, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data and analytics, technology operations, and innovation. The role is accountable for building a secure, reliable, scalable, and modern technology environment that enables high-quality virtual and hybrid care, an exceptional client, clinician, and patient experience, and operational excellence.

 The VP provides executive leadership for Teladoc Health Canada's digital strategy and multi-year technology roadmap, ensuring technology investments and product capabilities align with Canadian market needs, regulatory requirements, enterprise priorities, and Teladoc Health's global strategy. Working closely with clinical, commercial, operations, legal, privacy, compliance, and global technology leaders, the VP plays a key role in advancing Teladoc Health Canada's enterprise data governance framework and responsible use of data and AI, while delivering technology solutions that drive revenue growth, innovation, quality of care, security, and operational efficiency.

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

 Technology Strategy & Delivery 
 Develop and refresh Teladoc Health Canada’s digital strategy and multi-year technology roadmap aligned with organizational strategy and business objectives;

 Provide secure, scalable, resilient and sustainable digital solutions and technology infrastructure that meet Canadian business, market and regulatory requirements;

 Lead the strategy, design, development, delivery, and lifecycle management of Teladoc Health Canada’s technology ecosystem, including enterprise architecture, applications, integrations, infrastructure, and digital platforms;

 Develop and execute Teladoc Health Canada’s cybersecurity strategy, ensuring appropriate security controls, resilience, and cybersecurity risk management across technology platforms and information assets

 Own the budget, portfolio, and project management of digital initiatives and ongoing technology operations, ensuring disciplined prioritization, resource allocation, and value delivery; and

 Develop and manage strategic relationships with technology partners and vendors.

 Product Strategy & Delivery 
 Lead Teladoc Canada’s multi-year product roadmap to enable operational excellence, high-quality clinical care, commercial growth, and exceptional client, clinician and patient experiences;

 Translate market, regulatory, clinical, and operational requirements into innovative digital products;

 Champion user-centred design by incorporating the perspectives of clients, clinicians, patients, and internal users throughout the product lifecycle to deliver intuitive, accessible, and seamless digital experiences; and

 Integrate customer feedback, clinical insights, analytics, and user research into product planning, development and continuous improvement.

 Data, Analytics & AI Enablement 
 Lead the operational implementation of Teladoc Health Canada's enterprise data governance framework, including data architecture, stewardship, quality, metadata, lifecycle management, and data governance technologies, in partnership with the legal, privacy and compliance teams, and business stakeholders.

 Champion enterprise analytics, business intelligence, and AI-enabled capabilities that support operational excellence, clinical quality, innovation, and informed business decision-making.

 Develop and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable data management capabilities that enable high-quality clinical insights, operational intelligence, performance measurement, forecasting, and the responsible use of AI.

 Oversee enterprise data and analytics for the Canadian business, delivering timely, accurate, and actionable insights that support strategic planning, operational performance, and continuous improvement.

 Governance, Risk & Compliance 
 Partner with legal, privacy and compliance teams to ensure technology solutions meet applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, security, and clinical quality requirements, relevant market standards and clinical-quality expectations (e.g., PHIPA, PIPEDA, provincial health and privacy regulations, virtual care standards, responsible AI practices);

 Establish and oversee technology governance, including enterprise architecture, software development lifecycle (SDLC), cybersecurity, and cloud governance frameworks and processes, while partnering with the legal, privacy and compliance teams on enterprise data and AI governance and technology vendor risk management; and

 Identify, assess, and manage technology and cybersecurity risks by implementing appropriate controls, monitoring, and mitigation strategies to support the organization’s enterprise risk management framework, business resilience, audit readiness, and compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements.

 Technology Operations & Cybersecurity 
 Ensure reliable, scalable, and secure IT operations that support business continuity, organizational growth, and compliance with applicable organizational, contractual, and regulatory requirements;

 Oversee the performance, availability, and reliability of Teladoc Health Canada’s technology ecosystem through proactive monitoring, incident management, issue triage, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent recurrence and improve system resilience;

 Provide executive oversight of Teladoc Health Canada's cybersecurity program, including information security operations, vulnerability management, identity and access management, incident response, disaster recovery, business continuity, and continuous enhancement of security controls.

 Lead technology support services for clinicians, clients, and internal users, while coordinating with Global/International teams on shared platforms, infrastructure, devices (e.g., HHS, GSD), escalation management, and operational support.

 People, Culture & Capability Building 
 Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary technology organization;

 Strengthen organizational capabilities across product management, software engineering, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data and AI, cloud and infrastructure, and technology operations;

 Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, security-by-design, and user-centred product development.

 Qualifications Expected for Position

jobs.title: Director, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.  

 At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

 Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

 Position Summary 
 We are seeking a Director, Platform Engineering & DevOps to lead the development and maturation of our enterprise Platform Engineering organization.

 This leader will be responsible for building a modern, automation-first platform primarily focused on Microsoft Azure, while supporting remaining legacy workloads in AWS and on-premises data centers during the company's migration to Azure.

 The Director will lead the Platform Engineering team and partner closely with Network Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Security, and application Engineering to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and highly automated infrastructure platforms.

 A key objective of this role is to move the organization toward a self-service Platform Engineering model, enabling application teams to deploy and manage infrastructure using standardized patterns, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and cloud governance.

 Role and Responsibilities 
 Build, lead, and develop the Platform Engineering organization, including engineering strategy, roadmap, standards, and operating model.
 Lead the design and evolution of the company's enterprise Microsoft Azure platform, including landing zones, governance, identity, networking, security, observability, and resiliency.

 Support the migration of applications and infrastructure from AWS and on-premises environments to Azure.

 Establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation as the standard approach for provisioning and managing infrastructure.

 Develop reusable Terraform modules, CI/CD pipelines, reference architectures, and standardized deployment patterns.

 Build self-service platform capabilities and "golden paths" that improve developer productivity and reduce manual infrastructure provisioning.

 Partner with Network Engineering on hybrid cloud connectivity, cloud networking, Private Link, DNS, routing, firewalls, and application delivery.

 Partner with SRE to establish platform availability objectives, observability standards, resiliency practices, incident improvements, and operational readiness, leveraging Datadog Application

 Partner with SRE and Application Engineering to establish consistent standards for application and platform telemetry, including metrics, logs, distributed traces, dashboards, alerting, and service-level monitoring.

 Ensure cloud and platform services are appropriately instrumented and integrated with the enterprise observability platform.

 Partner with Security to implement secure-by-default platform patterns, cloud governance, policy enforcement, and compliance controls.

 Establish cloud cost-management and FinOps practices across Azure and remaining AWS environments.

 Recruit, mentor, and develop engineering leaders and senior technical talent.

 Provide executive-level communication regarding platform strategy, technology risks, investments, reliability, and cloud transformation progress.

 Required Qualifications 
 10+ years of progressive experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, Platform Engineering, systems engineering, or related disciplines, including significant engineering leadership experience.

 Deep technical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including enterprise cloud architecture, networking, security, governance, resiliency, and platform services.

 Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation, particularly Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based engineering workflows.

 Demonstrated experience leading complex cloud transformation initiatives, including hybrid environments, enterprise cloud migrations, or modernization of mission-critical infrastructure.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience building or leading an enterprise Platform Engineering organization or Internal Developer Platform.

 Working knowledge of AWS and experience supporting or migrating AWS workloads.

 Experience with Azure Landing Zones, Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Well-Architected Framework, and Azure Verified Modules.

 Experience with Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

 Experience with GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, GitHub Actions or comparable DevOps platforms.

 Experience with enterprise observability and APM platforms, preferably Datadog, and technologies such as OpenTelemetry.

 Experience implementing SRE practices including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, resiliency engineering, and incident management.

 Experience implementing cloud FinOps and cost optimization practices.

 Experience operating technology platforms in healthcare, SaaS, financial services, or another regulated environment.

 Success Metrics for the Role 
 Success will be measured by the Director's ability to build a scalable Platform Engineering organization and improve the speed, reliability, security, and efficiency of infrastructure delivery.
 Increased percentage of infrastructure deployed and managed through Infrastructure as Code.

 Increased adoption of standardized Azure landing zones, reusable platform services, and self-service capabilities.

 Reduced infrastructure provisioning and application deployment lead times.

 Progress migrating targeted AWS and on-premises workloads to Azure.

 Improved platform availability and achievement of defined SLOs.

 Increased adoption and effectiveness of standardized observability and APM practices across platform and application services, including improved service visibility and reduced mean time to detect and restore.

 Reduction in infrastructure-related incidents, configuration drift, and manual production changes.

 Improved developer satisfaction and adoption of Platform Engineering services.

 Improved cloud governance, security compliance, and cost efficiency.

 Successful recruitment, development, and retention of a high-performing Platform Engineering team.

 As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

 Why join Teladoc Health? 

 Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission. 

 Chart your career path with meaningful opportunities that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.

 Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day.  

 Contribute to an innovative culture where fresh ideas are valued as we increase access to care in new ways.   

 Enjoy an inclusive benefits program centered around you and your family, with tailored programs that address your unique needs.

 Explore candidate resources with tips and tricks from Teladoc Health recruiters and learn more about our company culture by exploring #TeamTeladocHealth on LinkedIn.

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, religion, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, medical condition, family history, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, parental status, or pregnancy). In our innovative and inclusive workplace, we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. 

 Teladoc Health respects your privacy and is committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your personal information. In furtherance of your employment relationship with Teladoc Health, we collect personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable data privacy laws, including but not limited to, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).  Personal information is defined as: Any information or set of information relating to you, including (a) all information that identifies you or could reasonably be used to identify you, and (b) all information that any applicable law treats as personal information. Teladoc Health’s Notice of Privacy Practices for U.S. Employees’ Personal information is available at this link.

jobs.title: Director and Practice Lead, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Who We Are 
 Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital agency and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.
 With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across: Digital Product Strategy & Innovation, Digital Marketing Services, Web & Mobile App Development, Data & AI, Cloud Engineering, and Enterprise Technology Modernization.
 From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

 Location & Flexibility 
 Our Director & Practice Lead, Data Engineering will operate remotely in Canada OR be based out of either our Toronto, ON or Vancouver, BC office locations.

 The Opportunity 
 TELUS Digital's Data, AI & Cloud (DAIC) practice is the multidisciplinary engine behind enterprise AI, blending boutique innovation with the breadth of a global services portfolio to help organizations architect, scale, and secure their transformations. Spanning our full family of specialized capabilities, the DAIC practice delivers end-to-end solutions across AI Advisory, AI Solutions, Data & AI Platforms, and Cloud Transformation.
 As a premier Google Cloud partner, our Cloud practice is at the forefront of helping enterprises adopt and scale on Google Cloud infrastructure: delivering complex engineering, deployment, and migration programs for some of the largest organizations in Canada and beyond.
 The Director & Practice Lead, Data Engineering will define and own the Data Engineering Practice along with its market positioning, P&L, talent, and the quality of work we deliver for clients. This role is for someone who has led data and AI practices before, understands how to turn messy enterprise data estates into strategic assets, and earns trust with C-suite executives through genuine expertise. You will shape how we help clients move from data ambition to durable, AI-ready infrastructure.
 This role will have four core anchor responsibilities:
 Strategy: Set the practice vision and align Data & AI capabilities to where enterprise demand is heading.

 P&L: Own revenue targets, margin, and growth while being accountable for the practice's full commercial performance.

 Talent & Culture: Build a practice where data-driven thinking, innovation, and engineering rigour are the baseline.

 Client Impact: Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise CxOs navigating data strategy, AI adoption, and governance.

 Responsibilities 
 Define the multi-year vision for the Data Engineering Practice, ensuring our technical capabilities are ahead of the curve for enterprise demand for Data & AI transformation.

 Own the full P&L, including pipeline, pricing, delivery margin, and revenue growth, while reporting directly to executive leadership with clear commercial accountability.

 Build and sustain senior relationships with Google Cloud partner teams and client executives to generate meaningful deal flow and expand strategic accounts.

 Lead the practice's position on ethical AI and data democratisation while making principled, evidence-based bets on where advanced analytics and AI are creating real enterprise value.

 Drive investment in reusable IP, data accelerators, and delivery assets that improve consistency, reduce time-to-value, and protect margins at scale.

 Serve as a strategic advisor to client C-suite executives, helping them define data strategy, navigate AI adoption, and build the organisational capabilities to sustain it.

 Set the standard for engineering and analytical excellence across the practice by hiring well, developing talent deliberately, and building teams that clients trust and return to.

 Competencies 
 12+ years in data or AI consulting, including at least 3–5 years in a practice leadership or executive role, not just senior delivery or individual contribution.

 Proven P&L ownership: Direct experience managing revenue, margin, and growth targets in a consulting or professional services context.

 Data and AI ecosystem depth: Strong command of modern data architecture, AI, and ML trends, cloud-native data platforms, and enterprise data governance.

 Executive communication: Able to advise, challenge, and build lasting trust with C-suite stakeholders on complex, ambiguous problems, not just present to them.

 Business Development track record: Experience generating pipeline and closing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements, not just managing delivery once work is sold.

 Talent leadership: Has hired, grown, and retained senior data engineering and consulting talent in a practice or delivery organisation.

 Equal Opportunity Employer 
 At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity. 
 We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.
 For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

This role ensures data driven insights are embedded across media planning, investment decisions, performance measurement, and executive reporting.

Working in close partnership with the International Business Insights & Analytics organization, this role implements and operates global measurement, reporting, and data governance frameworks within the Canadian market, ensuring alignment to global standards while delivering insights tailored to Canadian business needs.

This position plays a critical role in driving omnichannel measurement excellence, commercial performance, and operational insight across Walmart Connect Canada.  

 What you'll do... 
 Business Intelligence & Analytics 
 • Lead the strategy and execution of business intelligence, analytics, and performance measurement for Walmart Connect Canada.
 • Ensure analytics and insights inform media planning, optimization, and investment decisions.
 • Oversee omnichannel attribution and media effectiveness measurement across digital and in‑store channels.

 Global Measurement & Reporting Alignment 
 • Implement global measurement, reporting, and data governance frameworks within the Canadian market.
 • Partner with International Business Insights leaders to support consistent adoption of global standards.
 • Provide ongoing feedback related to framework effectiveness and local market considerations.

 Reporting & Performance Management 
 • Deliver Canada‑level executive reporting, including WBRs, MBRs, QBRs, and leadership reviews, aligned to global standards.

 Commercial Performance & Optimization

 Cross‑Functional & Cross‑Market Collaboration 
 • Serve as the primary point of contact between Walmart Connect Canada and the International Business Insights organization.

 • Support shared priorities while representing Canadian business requirements.

 People Leadership 
 • Build, lead, and develop a high‑performing Canada‑based analytics and insights team.

 • Foster a culture of analytical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

 Minimum Qualifications

 • Experience leading analytics or insights teams in a complex, cross‑functional organization.
 • Experience supporting executive‑level reporting and decision‑making.
 • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.

 Preferred Qualifications

 • Experience in retail media, advertising, marketplaces, or adjacent industries.
 • Experience working with global or regional analytics organizations.
 • Demonstrated ability to link insights to commercial performance and growth outcomes.
 • Walmart Connect or similar retail media experience.

 Core Competencies

 • Strong people leadership and talent development capabilities

 Building and converting a pipeline of high-value opportunities in the Canadian market — primarily in financial services — through a network earned over years of credible work in data & AI
 Selling from expertise: clients engage with you because you understand their problem because of your deep problem solving skills and experience not because you have a polished pitch
 Staying embedded in delivery long enough to set the right pace, challenge client assumptions, and keep teams focused on the actual business problem
 Bridging the gap between a senior data scientist and a C-suite conversation — translating technical constraints into strategic decisions and vice versa
 Raising the delivery bar by knowing what good looks like and holding teams to that standard

 What You'll Do
 Leverage your existing network to source, shape, and close high-value engagements in Canada (new logos, not just expansions)
 Translate complex business problems into concrete Data & AI solutions: identify where value can be created, make sure the team is building toward it, and hold the client accountable to realising it
 Lead and shape complex, tech-enabled transformations — from early problem definition through to scaled delivery — ensuring the right technology choices serve the business outcome, not the other way around
 Act as the senior point of contact for key clients throughout delivery, ensuring technical execution stays anchored to business value
 Challenge clients when necessary — on scope, pace, and ambition
 Work closely with our engineering and data science teams, providing business context, removing blockers and coaching them.

jobs.title: Senior Strategy Director
jobs.description:
This job posting is available in English and Canadian French. Please scroll down for the French version.
Cette offre d’emploi est disponible en anglais et en français (Canada). Veuillez faire défiler pour la version française. 
 ________________________________
 Remote | U.S. & Canada Only | Full-Time
 Compensation: 
 $150,000 USD (for U.S based candidates)
 $150,000 CAD (for Canadian based candidates)
 The Senior Strategy Director plays a central role in shaping how the agency thinks, plans, and delivers impact for clients. This role is responsible for defining strategic direction across priority accounts and ensuring that media, creative, SEO, CRM, web, and analytics teams are aligned to a unified business objective.
 This role requires an insight-driven mindset and the ability to translate complex business challenges into clear strategic direction. The Senior Strategy Director will guide growth diagnosis, define strategic priorities, and create the connective tissue across disciplines that ensures execution consistently ladders up to clear intent and measurable outcomes.
 At our agency, strategy is not a service line, it is how we work. The Senior Strategy Director ensures that insight, planning, and decision-making are embedded throughout the lifecycle of our client partnerships.
 About Level
 We’re an AI-powered performance marketing agency — built for precision, designed to scale, and powered by a scientific mindset. At Level, we blend strategy, media, creative, and machine intelligence to deliver outcomes that matter. Every time. At scale.
 We’ve been named one of Pittsburgh’s Best Places to Work and an Inc. 500 Fastest-Growing Company. Our clients span B2B, education, healthcare, financial services, ecommerce, and more.
 Your Role (and Impact)
 What You’ll Own: 
 Strategic Direction for Priority Accounts: You’ll lead strategic direction on high-impact client engagements, ensuring that marketing activities align with clear business objectives and growth opportunities. You’ll guide discovery, develop strategy briefs, and translate business challenges into structured, actionable plans.
 Strategic Planning & Roadmapping: You’ll contribute to annual and quarterly planning cycles by developing growth roadmaps tied to measurable outcomes. You’ll clarify priorities, define success metrics, and ensure teams are aligned around a shared understanding of strategic intent.
 Strategy Brief Development: You’ll own the development of strategy briefs that define business objectives, growth priorities, audience insights, positioning, channel approach, investment logic, and measurement frameworks. These briefs will serve as the foundation that aligns cross-functional teams before execution begins.
 Audience, Market & Category Insights: You’ll lead the development of audience insights, competitive analysis, and market intelligence that inform strategic recommendations. You’ll translate research and performance data into clear implications that guide decision-making across teams.
 Channel Strategy & Investment Planning: You’ll bring deep media strategy and planning expertise to define channel mix, sequencing, and investment logic that support growth objectives — fuelling full-funnel media plans that mature clients’ media programs beyond performance marketing and extend coverage across every stage of the customer journey, from awareness through retention. You’ll collaborate with media, CRM, SEO, and digital experience leaders to ensure channel decisions and budget allocation are aligned with the broader strategic framework.
 Measurement Frameworks & Performance Interpretation: You’ll establish measurement frameworks that define success before activation begins. You’ll help teams interpret performance signals, ensuring insights drive decisions rather than simply informing reporting.
 Strategic Performance Storytelling: You’ll lead strategic narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews and planning discussions, articulating what happened, why it happened, what was learned, and what actions should follow. Your storytelling will connect data, insights, and business implications into clear recommendations.
 Client Strategic Partnership: You’ll serve as a strategic partner for client stakeholders, confidently leading conversations around growth opportunities, planning priorities, and strategic recommendations. You’ll guide discussions beyond tactical execution toward long-term business impact.
 Cross-Disciplinary Strategic Alignment: You’ll act as the connective tissue across media, creative, SEO, CRM, web, and analytics teams to ensure that strategy is consistently integrated into execution. You’ll align KPIs, messaging, channel strategies, and measurement frameworks to ensure clear business intent.
 Strategy Enablement Across Teams: You’ll equip account and delivery teams with frameworks and guidance that elevate the quality and consistency of strategic thinking across the agency. Your work will help simplify planning and bring clarity to complex challenges.
 Strategic Standards & Framework Development: You’ll contribute to the evolution of agency-wide strategy frameworks, playbooks, and planning tools. You’ll help embed strategy into briefs, planning cycles, and optimization rhythms so that it becomes a core operating discipline.
 Thought Leadership & New Business Support: You’ll contribute to agency POVs, category playbooks, and growth narratives that strengthen our market differentiation. You’ll support new business opportunities through strategic storytelling and insight-driven positioning.
 Occasional travel may be requested for company events and industry conferences. 
 Skills & Qualifications:
 Strong experience developing integrated marketing strategies across multiple channels and disciplines.
 Proven media strategy and planning experience, with the ability to architect full-funnel, multi-stage media plans that mature clients' programs beyond performance marketing into upper- and mid-funnel brand and demand strategies.
 Ability to translate business objectives into clear strategic direction that guides cross-functional teams.
 Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from performance data, research, and market intelligence.
 Systems-thinking mindset with the ability to understand how messaging, channels, customer experience, and measurement connect.
 Excellent storytelling and communication skills, able to frame complex ideas in a clear and compelling narrative.
 Strong facilitation and collaboration skills, able to align cross-disciplinary teams around shared strategic priorities.
 Executive presence and confidence when presenting strategic recommendations to senior client stakeholders.
 Growth-oriented mindset with openness to feedback and continuous improvement.
 Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple planning cycles and strategic initiatives simultaneously.
 Comfort operating in ambiguous environments and bringing clarity to complex business challenges.
 Education & Experience:
 5+ years of experience in marketing strategy, integrated strategy, brand strategy, media strategy/planning, or growth strategy within an agency or client-side environment.
 Demonstrated experience building and evolving media strategies across the full customer journey, not limited to lower-funnel performance channels.
 Demonstrated experience developing cross-channel, integrated marketing strategies.
 Experience guiding annual planning, strategic roadmapping, and growth discussions with clients.
 Experience collaborating across media, creative, digital experience, CRM, and analytics teams.
 Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field.
 Industry experience in CPG or B2B is an asset but not required.
 Experience in the education sector (for-profit and/or not-for-profit institutions) is strongly preferred.
 AI Expectations
 At Level, proficiency with AI tools is a core part of your role—not a nice-to-have. Your success in this position depends not only on your functional expertise, but also on your ability to actively integrate AI into how you work.
 You are expected to:
 Experiment continuously with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) to improve the speed, quality, and impact of your work (e.g., draft briefs, summarize research, analyze data trends, generate initial strategic frameworks, identify patterns in large datasets).
 Proactively document and share what you learn—your prompts, process improvements, and use cases—so others can benefit and we can grow together.
 Approach AI with an iterative mindset, refining how you apply it to your work over time. The first idea is rarely the best; testing, tweaking, and improving is part of the process.
 Lean into discomfort, especially when tools or workflows feel unfamiliar. Growth happens when you're stretching beyond what's comfortable or routine.
 AI is not a shortcut—it’s a skillset. You’re expected to use it as a force multiplier for creativity, strategy, and execution, not as a substitute for thoughtful work. As our tools evolve, your ability to adapt and lead through change will be a key part of your performance and growth at Level.
 Our Core Values
 No Ego, All In 
We don’t do “that’s not my job.” We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart.
 Better Every Day 
We want the feedback — even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar.
 Relentless for Results 
Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward.
 Driven by Truth 
We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear — not just what is easy to say.
 Perks & Benefits
 At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.
 Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
 Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
 Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
 Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
 Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities
 Remote First
 This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents and is fully remote. Occasional travel may be requested for company events and industry conferences. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.
 Level Is Built on Inclusion
 We are committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Level is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer — we celebrate what makes you, you. Level Agency provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities during the recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know during your application or interview process.
 Ready to Apply?
 Click below to submit your resume. You’ll also answer a few thoughtful questions, so take your time.
 We care more about how you think, how you build, and how you create impact than whether your path has been perfectly linear.
 Let’s build something together. 
 AI Hiring Disclaimer 
 We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our hiring process, including resume screening and interview note-taking or summarization. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by Level's hiring team. 
_____________________________________________
 Télétravail - États-Unis et Canada seulement | Temps plein
 Rémunération:
 150 000 $ US (pour les personnes candidates résidant aux États-Unis)
 150 000 $ CA (pour les personnes candidates résidant au Canada)
 Le directeur principal ou la directrice principale de la stratégie joue un rôle central dans la façon dont l'agence réfléchit, planifie et génère de l'impact pour ses clients. Ce rôle est responsable de définir l'orientation stratégique des comptes prioritaires et de veiller à ce que les équipes média, création, SEO, CRM, web et analytique soient alignées sur un objectif d'affaires commun.
 Ce rôle exige un esprit axé sur les insights et la capacité de traduire des défis d'affaires complexes en une orientation stratégique claire. Le directeur principal ou la directrice principale de la stratégie pilotera le diagnostic de croissance, définira les priorités stratégiques et créera les liens entre les disciplines pour que l'exécution soit toujours alignée sur une intention claire et des résultats mesurables.
 Dans notre agence, la stratégie n'est pas une gamme de services, c'est notre façon de travailler. Le directeur principal ou la directrice principale de la stratégie veille à ce que les insights, la planification et la prise de décision soient intégrés à chaque étape du cycle de vie de nos partenariats clients.
 À propos de Level
 Nous sommes une agence de marketing de performance propulsée par l’IA — bâtie pour la précision, conçue pour évoluer et guidée par une mentalité scientifique. Chez Level, nous combinons stratégie, médias, création et intelligence machine pour livrer des résultats qui comptent. Chaque fois. À grande échelle.
 Nous avons été nommés parmi les meilleurs lieux de travail de Pittsburgh et reconnus comme l’une des entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide du classement Inc. 500. Nos clients œuvrent notamment en B2B, en éducation, en santé, en services financiers, en commerce électronique et dans plusieurs autres secteurs.
 Votre rôle et votre impact
 Vos responsabilités: 
 Orientation stratégique des comptes prioritaires: Vous dirigerez l'orientation stratégique de mandats clients à fort impact, en veillant à ce que les activités marketing soient alignées sur des objectifs d'affaires clairs et des occasions de croissance. Vous piloterez la phase de découverte, rédigerez des briefs stratégiques et transformerez les défis d'affaires en plans structurés et concrets.
 Planification stratégique et feuilles de route: Vous contribuerez aux cycles de planification annuels et trimestriels en élaborant des feuilles de route de croissance liées à des résultats mesurables. Vous clarifierez les priorités, définirez les indicateurs de succès et veillerez à ce que les équipes partagent une compréhension commune de l'intention stratégique.
 Élaboration des briefs stratégiques: Vous serez responsable de l'élaboration des briefs stratégiques qui définissent les objectifs d'affaires, les priorités de croissance, les insights sur l'audience, le positionnement, l'approche par canal, la logique d'investissement et les cadres de mesure. Ces briefs serviront de fondation pour aligner les équipes multidisciplinaires avant le début de l'exécution.
 Insights sur l'audience, le marché et la catégorie: Vous dirigerez l'élaboration des insights sur l'audience, de l'analyse concurrentielle et de la veille de marché qui alimentent les recommandations stratégiques. Vous traduirez la recherche et les données de performance en implications claires qui orientent la prise de décision dans toutes les équipes.
 Stratégie de canaux et planification des investissements: Vous mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en stratégie et en planification média pour définir le mix de canaux, le séquençage et la logique d'investissement qui soutiennent les objectifs de croissance. Vous alimenterez des plans média full-funnel qui font évoluer les programmes média des clients au-delà du marketing de performance et couvrent chaque étape du parcours client, de la notoriété à la fidélisation. Vous collaborerez avec les leaders média, CRM, SEO et expérience numérique pour que les choix de canaux et l'allocation budgétaire soient alignés sur le cadre stratégique global.
 Cadres de mesure et interprétation de la performance: Vous établirez des cadres de mesure qui définissent le succès avant l'activation. Vous aiderez les équipes à interpréter les signaux de performance, pour que les insights guident les décisions plutôt que de simplement alimenter les rapports.
 Récit stratégique de la performance: Vous dirigerez le récit stratégique des revues d'affaires trimestrielles (QBR) et des discussions de planification, en expliquant ce qui s'est passé, pourquoi, ce que nous avons appris et quelles actions doivent suivre. Votre récit reliera les données, les insights et les implications d'affaires pour en tirer des recommandations claires.
 Partenariat stratégique avec les clients: Vous serez un partenaire stratégique pour les parties prenantes clients et mènerez avec assurance les conversations sur les occasions de croissance, les priorités de planification et les recommandations stratégiques. Vous amènerez les discussions au-delà de l'exécution tactique, vers un impact d'affaires à long terme.
 Alignement stratégique multidisciplinaire: Vous ferez le lien entre les équipes média, création, SEO, CRM, web et analytique pour que la stratégie soit intégrée de façon constante à l'exécution. Vous harmoniserez les indicateurs clés, les messages, les stratégies de canaux et les cadres de mesure afin d'assurer une intention d'affaires claire.
 Habilitation stratégique des équipes: Vous outillerez les équipes de comptes et de livraison avec des cadres et des conseils qui rehaussent la qualité et la cohérence de la réflexion stratégique dans toute l'agence. Votre travail aidera à simplifier la planification et à clarifier les défis complexes.
 Normes et cadres stratégiques: Vous contribuerez à l'évolution des cadres, des guides et des outils de planification stratégique de l'agence. Vous aiderez à intégrer la stratégie aux briefs, aux cycles de planification et aux rythmes d'optimisation, pour qu'elle devienne une discipline centrale de nos opérations.
 Leadership éclairé et soutien aux nouvelles affaires: Vous contribuerez aux points de vue de l'agence, aux guides sectoriels et aux récits de croissance qui renforcent notre différenciation sur le marché. Vous appuierez le développement des affaires par un récit stratégique et un positionnement fondé sur les insights.
 Des déplacements occasionnels pourraient être requis pour des événements d’entreprise et des conférences de l’industrie. 
 Compétences et qualifications:
 Solide expérience dans l'élaboration de stratégies marketing intégrées couvrant plusieurs canaux et disciplines.
 Expérience démontrée en stratégie et planification média, avec la capacité de concevoir des plans média full-funnel à plusieurs étapes qui amènent les programmes des clients au-delà du marketing de performance, vers des stratégies de marque et de demande en haut et au milieu de l'entonnoir.
 Capacité à traduire des objectifs d'affaires en une orientation stratégique claire qui guide les équipes multidisciplinaires.
 Solides compétences analytiques et capacité à tirer des insights pertinents des données de performance, de la recherche et de la veille de marché.
 Pensée systémique et capacité à comprendre comment les messages, les canaux, l'expérience client et la mesure s'articulent.
 Excellentes aptitudes en narration et en communication, avec la capacité de présenter des idées complexes de façon claire et convaincante.
 Solides compétences en animation et en collaboration, avec la capacité de rallier des équipes multidisciplinaires autour de priorités stratégiques communes.
 Prestance et assurance lors de la présentation de recommandations stratégiques à des parties prenantes clients de haut niveau.
 Esprit de croissance, ouverture à la rétroaction et souci d'amélioration continue.
 Solides compétences organisationnelles et capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs cycles de planification et initiatives stratégiques.
 Aisance dans des contextes ambigus et capacité à apporter de la clarté à des défis d'affaires complexe
 Formation et expérience:
 Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en stratégie marketing, stratégie intégrée, stratégie de marque, stratégie et planification média ou stratégie de croissance, en agence ou chez l'annonceur.
 Expérience démontrée dans l'élaboration et l'évolution de stratégies média couvrant l'ensemble du parcours client, sans se limiter aux canaux de performance en bas de l'entonnoir.
 Expérience démontrée dans l'élaboration de stratégies marketing intégrées et multicanales.
 Expérience dans la conduite de la planification annuelle, de l'élaboration de feuilles de route stratégiques et des discussions de croissance avec les clients.
 Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes média, création, expérience numérique, CRM et analytique.
 Baccalauréat en marketing, en administration des affaires, en communication ou dans un domaine connexe.
 Une expérience dans le secteur CPG ou B2B est un atout, mais n'est pas requise.
 Une expérience dans le secteur de l'éducation (établissements à but lucratif ou sans but lucratif) est fortement souhaitée.
 Attentes liées à l’IA
 Chez Level, la maîtrise des outils d'IA est un élément central de votre rôle, pas un simple atout. Votre succès dans ce poste repose non seulement sur votre expertise, mais aussi sur votre capacité à intégrer activement l'IA dans votre façon de travailler.
 Vous devrez:
 Expérimenter continuellement avec des outils d'IA (p. ex. ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) pour améliorer la rapidité, la qualité et l'impact de votre travail (p. ex. rédiger des briefs, résumer de la recherche, analyser des tendances, générer des cadres stratégiques préliminaires, repérer des modèles dans de grands ensembles de données).
 Documenter et partager de façon proactive ce que vous apprenez, comme vos requêtes, vos améliorations de processus et vos cas d'utilisation, pour que les autres en profitent et que nous progressions ensemble.
 Aborder l'IA avec un esprit itératif en raffinant au fil du temps la façon dont vous l'appliquez à votre travail. La première idée est rarement la meilleure: tester, ajuster et améliorer fait partie du processus.
 Accepter l'inconfort, surtout lorsque des outils ou des façons de faire vous semblent peu familiers. C'est en sortant de sa zone de confort et de sa routine qu'on grandit.
 L'IA n'est pas un raccourci, c'est une compétence. Vous devrez l'utiliser comme multiplicateur de force pour la création, la stratégie et l'exécution, et non comme substitut à un travail réfléchi. À mesure que nos outils évoluent, votre capacité à vous adapter et à mener le changement jouera un rôle clé dans votre performance et votre croissance chez Level.
 Nos valeurs fondamentales
 No Ego, All In 
Ici, on ne dit pas « ce n’est pas mon travail ». Nous gagnons ensemble, nous mettons la main à la pâte quand c’est nécessaire et nous nous soucions davantage du résultat que de l’organigramme.
 Better Every Day 
Nous voulons recevoir la rétroaction — même quand elle pique. Nous testons, apprenons, nous adaptons et continuons à élever la barre.
 Relentless for Results 
L’activité ne vaut rien sans résultats. Nous nous concentrons sur le travail qui fait avancer l’entreprise.
 Driven by Truth 
Nous remettons les hypothèses en question, suivons les données et disons aux clients ce qu’ils doivent entendre — pas seulement ce qui est facile à dire.
 Avantages et bénéfices
 Chez Level, nous soutenons nos équipes aux États-Unis et au Canada avec des avantages conçus pour favoriser la flexibilité, le bien-être et la croissance à long terme.
 Télétravail complet aux États-Unis et au Canada, allocation mensuelle pour le travail à domicile et vendredis d’été
 Congés généreux, incluant des congés payés illimités aux États-Unis, des vacances concurrentielles au Canada et des options de congé parental/familial
 Avantages complets en santé, soutien en santé mentale et assurances invalidité et vie payées par l’entreprise
 Cotisations de retraite de l’employeur, 401(k) aux États-Unis et contribution REER au Canada
 Évaluations de performance trimestrielles et occasions d’avancement professionnel
 Priorité au télétravail
 Ce rôle est ouvert aux résidentes et résidents des États-Unis et du Canada et se fait entièrement à distance. Des déplacements occasionnels pourraient être requis pour des événements d’entreprise et des conférences de l’industrie. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de commanditer des visas pour le moment.
 Level est fondée sur l’inclusion
 Nous sommes engagés envers la diversité, l’équité, l’inclusion et le sentiment d’appartenance. Level est fière d’être un employeur souscrivant au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi — nous célébrons ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes. Level Agency offre des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables aux personnes candidates en situation de handicap tout au long du processus de recrutement. Si vous avez besoin d'une mesure d'adaptation, veuillez nous en informer lors de votre candidature ou de votre processus d'entrevue.
 Prêt(e) à postuler?
 Cliquez ci-dessous pour soumettre votre CV. Vous répondrez aussi à quelques questions réfléchies, alors prenez le temps de bien le faire.
 Ce qui nous importe le plus, c’est votre façon de penser, de bâtir et de créer de l’impact — pas que votre parcours ait été parfaitement linéaire.
 Bâtissons quelque chose ensemble. 
 Divulgation sur l'utilisation de l'IA dans l'embauche 
 Nous utilisons des outils assistés par l'IA pour appuyer certaines étapes de notre processus d'embauche, notamment la présélection des CV ainsi que la prise de notes ou la production de résumés d'entrevues. Ces outils soutiennent le jugement humain, mais ne le remplacent pas. Toutes les décisions d'embauche sont prises par l'équipe d'embauche de Level.

jobs.title: Senior Director - Enterprise Performance, Evaluation and Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
Position Title: Senior Director – Enterprise Performance, Evaluation and Strategic Initiatives
 Employment Status: Permanent Full Time 
 Position Status: This is a Non-Bargaining Unit position
 This posting is for a new vacancy.
 Hours of Work: Monday to Friday, 35 Hours
 Position Reports to: Chief Executive Officer
 Salary Range: $ 125,000 - $140,000, commensurate on skills and experience, plus participation in HOOPP and Group Benefits.
 Primary work location: Oshawa (Hybrid work environment); Staff may be requested to work out of other DCHC’s sites in Pickering, Whitby, Ajax, Oshawa South and Oshawa North (Airport Road) as required.
 Direct Reports: 5 
 ·        Manager 
 ·        Quality Improvement Coordinator - 1
 ·        Health Information Specialist - 1
 ·        Data Analyst - 2

Organization 
 Who We Are: Durham Community Health Centre (DCHC) is a charitable registered organization that provides integrated, accessible, and equitable community-based primary care, wellness services, and health education for Durham community members facing barriers to health and well-being.

 Who We Serve: DCHC offers equity-focused programs and services for priority populations, including Indigenous peoples, Black communities, 2SLGBTQI+ community members, newcomers to Canada, seniors, and clients without a family doctor. This approach helps community members access both preventive care and care when they are ill.

 How We Work: Our interprofessional team includes physicians, nurse practitioners, nurses, counsellors, dietitians, outreach workers, medical secretaries, and administrative staff. Together, we place each client at the centre of care and respond to their needs through integrated clinical care, wellness support, and health education.

 Why Join Now: This is an exciting time to join DCHC as we advance an energizing path toward greater impact in local health care. Guided by our Strategic Plan, Theory of Change, brand, client stories, and resources, we are diversifying, expanding, and strengthening how we serve the community.

 Position Overview 
 Durham Community Health Center (DCHC) is seeking an exceptional, self-driven leader to take on the role of Senior Director, Enterprise Performance, Evaluation and Strategic Initiatives. The role demands a leader who thrives in complexity, excels in driving enterprise-wide performance, and is relentless in the pursuit of excellence.

 At DCHC we are committed to a collaborative culture where strategic thinking, execution discipline and shared leadership are at the core of everything we do. As a key member of the Executive Leadership Team, the Senior Director will be responsible for aligning enterprise performance, strategic initiatives, and quality improvement with DCHC’s long-term vision.

 This role is a unique opportunity for an innovative leader to build high-impact frameworks for evaluation, decision support, special project execution and quality transformation. The right candidate will be a visionary, a doer and a collaborator; someone who can seamlessly transition between strategy and execution while fostering an organizational culture of continuous improvement and strategic excellence.

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 As a member of the Executive Leadership Team and strategic advisor to the CEO, the Senior Director provides enterprise leadership across strategy execution, performance intelligence, transformation, risk, quality, accreditation, and organizational alignment.

 1. Enterprise Strategy & Execution 
 ·         Translate DCHC’s strategic plan into clear annual priorities, business operating plans, performance measures, and funder accountabilities.
 ·         Lead enterprise strategy execution and monitor progress against strategic commitments, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and long-term strategic objectives.
 ·         Ensure alignment between Board priorities, CEO direction, ELT accountabilities, resource management, and organizational initiatives execution.

 2. Enterprise Performance & Intelligence 
 ·         Establish DCHC’s enterprise performance management framework.
 ·         Develop integrated, real-time dashboards, scorecards, quality indicators, and performance reporting tools.
 ·         Lead enterprise analytics, program evaluation, KPIs, outcome measurement, governance reporting, and data-informed decision-making.
 ·         Provide the CEO and ELT with timely intelligence focusing on trends to support strategic decisions and performance improvement.

 3. Strategic Initiatives & Transformation 
 ·         Lead CEO and ELT-sponsored strategic initiatives, complex enterprise projects, and transformational initiatives that improve service delivery and operational effectiveness.
 ·         Establish clear governance framework, milestones, accountabilities, and measures for all organizational initiatives aligned to DCHC corporate balance scorecard.

 4. Enterprise Risk, Quality & Organizational Excellence 
 ·         Lead the enterprise risk management strategy, including proactive risk identification, mitigation, monitoring, annual planning, and reporting.
 ·         Lead DCHC’s enterprise Quality Improvement and accreditation strategy, including organization-wide QI frameworks, and compliance reporting.
 ·         Integrate quality, risk, performance, evaluation, and continuous improvement into one enterprise framework.
 ·         Strengthen organizational resilience, accountability, and readiness for emerging challenges.

 5. CEO Advisory & Enterprise Alignment 
 ·         Serve as a strategic advisor to the Office of the CEO.
 ·         Provide executive analysis, strategic options, decision support, and recommendations that enhance program and organizational effectiveness.
 ·         Lead CEO Office strategic operating plans and priority tracking.
 ·         Identify and resolve cross-portfolio dependencies, competing priorities, and organizational barriers that could impede enterprise execution.
 ·         Champion One DCHC, One Strategy, One Enterprise.

 Strategic Mandate 
 The Senior Director ensures DCHC has the clarity, intelligence, discipline, and execution capability to turn strategy into measurable organizational and community collective impact.

 QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE 
 Education & Certifications 
 ·        Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, Business Administration, or a related field (master’s preferred) 
 ·        PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Change Management or a relevant performance excellence certification is an asset.

 Experience & Skills
